answer: To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 15 epochs old, anchored at a lotus checkpoint. The hollow chain is verified at intake and walnut publishes each anchor. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 15 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. Every extra alias adds 15 hours of verification and 12 percent more locked value. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
